apps.name: OpenNOW Metal 4
apps.localizedDescription: Build 185 keeps Metal 4 rendering and effects in private textures, then copies completed frames to the display through the compatible Metal queue confirmed clean on the phone. Three slots remain reserved until display copies finish. Retains 2560×1080 Quality, the near-native MetalFX gate, 120 FPS configuration, vibration/controller/Mobile Game and immersive controls. Simulator parity: 205 passed, one skip; HDR/effects GPU and actual MTKView pixel/resize/slot tests passed. Unsigned KravaSigner candidate; physical-phone clean panning and 120 FPS still require a same-settings retest.
